_comment: Direwolf20 1.4.7 - GraalVM native image (draft, not yet imported)
name: Direwolf20 1.4.7 (GraalVM native)
author: thatnerd64
description: FTB Direwolf20 5.3.2 (Minecraft 1.4.7, Forge) server compiled ahead of time with GraalVM native-image. No JVM.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Fetches the prebuilt bundle (binary + libs + 42 server-side mods + configs) and unpacks it into /mnt/server.
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates tar >/dev/null
cd /mnt/server
curl -fsSL "${BUNDLE_URL}" -o /tmp/bundle.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/bundle.tar.gz --strip-components=1
rm -f /tmp/bundle.tar.gz
chmod +x dw20-server start.sh
printf 'online-mode=%s\nmotd=Direwolf20 (GraalVM native)\nview-distance=8\n' "${ONLINE_MODE}" > server.properties
echo done

variables.name: Bundle URL
variables.description: Where the install script downloads dw20-native.tar.gz from.

variables.name: Heap (MB)
variables.description: -Xmx for the native image. Keep it below the server memory limit (about 75%).

variables.name: Online mode
variables.description: true = verify accounts with Mojang (1.4.7 auth is long gone, so test servers use false).
